About Titans

Britain’s Property
Entrepreneurs’ Community

At Titans we share knowledge through education at our events, learn from other people’s experience through networking, and build long-term professional relationships.

Who we are

AboutTitans

Titans isn’t just an event. It’s a movement fuelled by the shared desire to learn, grow and achieve more through collaboration.

Feeling isolated in the property game? Titans brings together experienced developers, investors and business owners to connect, collaborate and propel each other’s success. Imagine building a power team of industry veterans - that is what the room is for.

The co-founders, Romey and Manni Chopra, pour their hearts into creating an environment overflowing with valuable connections, support and opportunities. They understand that your property business thrives on the strength of the network around you.

Collaborate

Unlock a world of shared knowledge and expertise to propel your property ventures to new heights.

Connect

Meet experienced developers, investors and business owners like never before - in one room, every month.

Empower

Access resources and support systems designed around helping you actually hit your property goals.

Our Belief

Property creates income.
Income creates choices.

Six words for why Titans exists.

What drives us

Vision,missionandpurpose

01

Our Vision

To inspire one million people in our lifetime to create a secondary income through property, giving them greater choice over how they live, work and shape their future.

We believe property can be more than an investment. It can create security, independence, opportunity and, most importantly, choice.

02

Our Mission

To inspire, connect and empower property entrepreneurs with the knowledge, relationships, opportunities and support they need to build successful property businesses and create greater financial freedom.

We bring ambitious people together to learn, collaborate and take action - because we believe nobody should have to build their property journey alone.

03

Our Purpose

To give people greater choice over how they live and work by empowering them to create additional income through property.

Someone building a small second income and someone building a £20m property business both belong to the same movement.

The founders

ThepeoplewhostartedTitans

Two developers, 25+ years of joint experience, and one belief: the right people around you change everything.

Manni Chopra

Joint Founder & Host

Developer | Entrepreneur | Author | Mentor | Host

Originally from Mumbai, Manni Chopra has become a leading voice in UK property over the past 14+ years. Her journey is driven by passion, purpose, and a commitment to empowering others through knowledge and connection. Together with her husband Romey she runs Chopra Property Group - over 25 years transforming properties throughout Berkshire and nearby areas, identifying undervalued opportunities and breathing new life into them through refurbishments, conversions and developments.

  • Host of Passion 4 Property
  • Author of “Cash Rich, Time Rich” and “Property Expert’s Money Making Secrets”
  • Creator of TITANS - a 100+ strong property network
  • Multi-award-winning property developer

Romey Chopra

Joint Founder & Host

MBA | Developer | Investor

Romey has spent over 20 years in business, from Pharma to property development. After his MBA he started several successful businesses across Europe and Asia. He is passionate about creating high-value properties and improving living standards, especially for vulnerable populations, and leverages his experience in negotiation, finance and project management to identify hidden potential in properties and bring them to life.

  • 20+ years across pharma and property
  • Businesses founded in Europe and Asia
  • Specialist in negotiation, finance & project management
  • Focused on high-value, high-standard developments
Why Titans

WhyyoushouldjoinTitans

Success in property today demands more than strategy. It demands connection.

You stop building alone

Feeling isolated in the property game? Titans brings experienced developers, investors and business owners together to connect, collaborate and propel each other’s success.

You build a real power team

Solicitors, accountants, planning consultants, architects, contractors, tax advisers, RICS surveyors, agents and structural specialists - all in one room, all vetted by the community.

VIP coffee mornings

Curated monthly sessions hosted by Manni Chopra, featuring planning experts, marketing strategists and industry leaders sharing actionable insight over real conversation.

You stay ahead of the change

The only constant in property is change. Regulation, compliance, funding, finance and planning all move - Titans keeps you current instead of catching up.

It’s a community, not a mailing list

When you join Titans you’re stepping into a thriving, invite-only community that supports your growth, fuels your ambition and empowers your next move.

Bonds beyond business

Axe throwing, BBQ socials, golf days, escape rooms - shared experiences that turn professionals into collaborators, and collaborators into friends.

If you’re serious about growing in the property space, this is where your journey levels up.

Let’s grow, together.
